newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - LASMO SHARES ON WAY TO 320P.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - LASMO SHARES ON WAY TO 320P.

text.p: DAY'S RANGE * SUPPORT * RESTNCE* MA-50 * MA-200
+ Lasmo shares have the potential to go up to 320p following a chart breakout from 280p recently, technical analysts said.

+ Such a move would allow the stock to catch up with the oil exploration sector which it has lagged since 1996. It will not be immune to stock market turbulence but such buffeting will allow the divergence between its 50- and 200-day moving averages to reduce before the shares are ready to burst higher.
Shares in oil and gas explorer Lasmo are capable of cruising up to 320p following recent chart breakout from 280p, technical analysts said on Tuesday.

"The shares have been marking time for a couple of months just below 280p, but the move to 287p puts them into new high ground and confirms their attraction once more," said David Charters, managing director at Investment Research of Cambridge Ltd.
The stock's upward march since July when it hit a low of 259p may be strong enough to lift Lasmo towards 320p, he added.
By 0900 GMT, Lasmo shares were up 1/2p to 281p.
This year, the shares began to trend higher after reaching a low of 223p in May and they sailed past previous resistance at 260p.

Sideways consolidation from June provided a pause in the stock's uptrend as it bounced between 260p-280p but analysts believe once the current stock market turbulence is over the stock should be free to glide higher.
The oil exploration sector itself has been flattening out since June but its long-term uptrend since 1996 -- in which it has made an 80 percent gain -- has not ended, they said.

Over the same period, Lasmo shares have achieved a share price rise of only 60 percent but they look ready to catch up with the sector and although the consolidation phase in June made them underperform slightly against the All-Share index, they have been making a slow comeback over the past few weeks.
Divergence between Lasmo's 50 and 200 day moving averages has widened by 28 points and there has been a tendency for the share price to pause after such divergence before resuming the uptrend.
The shares are likely to be buffeted owing to the current stock market volatility but this will serve to reduce the divergence between the moving averages before they swing higher.
